title: Mute CGB voices in sequence previews
changes: Add a sequence player checkbox that mutes identified CGB voices during playback, including resolved key-map tones and sine fallbacks, while leaving unidentified voices audible.
Retain the checkbox across track and song changes and restore it after reload when browser storage is available.
validation: Synthetic Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-cgb-mute-corrected-xm0rn7ys checked CGB and non-CGB routing, live toggles, key maps, sine mode, track and song changes, reload persistence and existing controls.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-cgb-mute-eur-audible-898xw9ja checked an extracted CGB note, live Web Audio mute and unmute after rendering began and selection persistence. Earlier EUR units ugz8wd_8 and sspgch_4 observed gain before rendering; a focused Sol 6.1/xhigh consultation identified the timing issue, with effective settings unconfirmed.
limitations: Unidentified instruments cannot be classified and remain audible. Physical audio, original-game CGB behavior and Windows were not verified. The large-JSON prototype remains suspended.
